status: Đua Gió has three authored short courses with rising hazard density, rival pace and road curvature; top-three qualification, current-place feedback, sequential unlock/replay, and saved best-place/time records. Attacking only when a rider is in range moves the final course from 3rd to 2nd with no added player time. Reckless attempts produce 11/12/12 misses and add 0.116/0.126/0.126 s. This is model evidence, not human balance acceptance. Real browser/device and player review remain pending; historical title/route rights are unverified.
